patterns.pattern: EVM wallet env vars use WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY_{NAME} not PRIVATE_KEY_{NAME}. Solana uses SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY_{NAME}.
Most Base and Arbitrum tokens only have USDC liquidity on 1inch/Uniswap. Native ETH swaps return INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY. ALWAYS prefer USDC as buy-side capital on L2 chains.

When available capital (USDC or native) doesn't cover full Kelly-sized position, cap at 90% of available balance rather than falling back to a different token. This ensures trades execute with smaller capital.

DailyFloorGuardian persists to disk and can lock ALL trading with a stale floor. After large drawdowns, position closures, or fresh capital deployment, ALWAYS reset via force_set_floor(). Check output/daily_floor.json on VPS.
Use 50 (neutral) as fallback for missing indicators, never 0. Zero zeroes out the weighted average composite score.

Sequential external API calls in scoring loops are the #1 performance bottleneck. enrich_candidate() makes 6-7 sequential Moralis calls per token. DexScreener has 1-second rate limit per call. ALWAYS parallelize with ThreadPoolExecutor where possible.

DexScreener batch endpoint (GET /tokens/v1/{chain}/{comma_addresses}, max 30) is implemented in dexscreener.py line 203 but NEVER called in the scan loop. Moralis has batch analytics (30/call) and batch pricing (25/call). Always check for unused batch endpoints before adding serial calls.

Inspired by ECC (affaan-m/ECC): Add automatic logging hooks that capture every trade decision (entry/exit/skip) with full context (signals, guardrails checked, outcome). Don't rely on manual triggers for episodic memory.

Inspired by ECC: Trading bot autonomous loops (position monitor, scanner, executor) need circuit breakers. Apply 5-layer guards: (1) max retries, (2) exponential backoff, (3) re-entrancy check, (4) time-based abort, (5) memory throttle.

Inspired by ECC: Periodically cluster accumulated trade experiences to discover emergent patterns — winning signal combos, dangerous market conditions, time-of-day effects. Threshold: only promote patterns after N=3+ successful applications.

When most alpha wallet signals target a disabled chain (e.g., Ethereum removed for gas cost), the copy-trade pipeline produces zero trades. Hyperliquid perps fallback helps but has its own gem_score gate. Monitor which chains alpha signals concentrate on and ensure at least one execution venue covers them.
Manus AI commits sometimes contain Python syntax errors (nested quotes in f-strings, import mismatches). ALWAYS run ast.parse() on every file Manus modified before deploying to VPS.

Hyperliquid Unified accounts store funds in spot clearinghouse, NOT perps margin. user_state() returns $0 for Unified mode. ALWAYS query spot_user_state() first — if USDC balance > 0, use it. Only fall back to user_state() for Cross margin accounts. New HL accounts default to Unified mode.

patterns.pattern: Hyperliquid Exchange() MUST be initialized with a real eth_account.Account wallet object, never wallet=None. Without the wallet, all transaction signing silently fails — open_long/open_short return None. Use: Account.from_key(private_key).

CRITICAL: Hyperliquid SDK market_open() signature is market_open(name, is_buy, sz, px=None, slippage=0.05). The 4th POSITIONAL arg is px (price), NOT slippage. Passing slippage as positional arg (e.g., market_open(sym, True, size, 0.03)) sets price=$0.03, causing 'Order price >95% away from reference' rejection. ALWAYS use keyword arg: market_open(sym, True, size, slippage=0.03).
patterns.evolution: 2026-06-17: CRITICAL pattern — this single bug prevented ALL fills for 4+ hours

patterns.pattern: Hyperliquid Unified accounts CANNOT use usd_class_transfer() or transfer_between_spot_and_perp(). HL returns 'Action disabled when unified account is active'. Unified mode auto-shares equity — perps can use Spot USDC as margin directly. Do NOT try to transfer funds between Spot and Perps in Unified mode.

Hyperliquid market_open() can return status='ok' even when the order fails. The actual fill/rejection is in response.data.statuses[0]. Always check for 'error' key in statuses AND verify fills via info.user_fills() before reporting FILLED. IOC orders can cancel without filling.

When HL SDK docs are unclear, use runtime introspection on VPS: (1) dir(Exchange) to list methods, (2) inspect.getsource(Exchange.method) to read source, (3) inspect.signature() for args. The installed SDK version may differ from online docs.

HYPERLIQUID_MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE caps total leveraged exposure across all positions. When exceeded, new trades are silently rejected (executor returns None with no logging). Set this to 3-4x the account value to allow reasonable diversification. With $150 account and 3x leverage, $150 cap only allows 2 positions.

WARNING: The HL executor tracks TP/SL internally in self.positions dict but does NOT place corresponding limit/stop orders on the exchange. If the bot restarts, there is ZERO exit protection on open positions. This needs to be fixed with exchange.order() using limit and trigger order types.

patterns.pattern: Daily goal engine modes (protect at 100%, bank_it at 150%) severely throttle trading when profit targets are reached. For aggressive growth phase, enable PARABOLIC_MODE_ENABLED=true to keep trading at full speed after goal. Remove profit-side trade caps from ShamrockGuard. KEEP the drawdown guard (loss protection).
